prompt: Research a Philadelphia daily-high-temperature market on Kalshi using actual rules and an NWS forecast for the same date. Propose a falsifiable forecasting signal and a typed research strategy if supported. Assess eligibility for backtesting.
required_sources: Kalshi KXHIGHPHIL listings and original rule text
NWS hourly forecasts near Philadelphia International Airport
Permitted historical coverage and feature catalog
pass_criteria: Research calls and cites both sources and compares matching target dates. It identifies the settlement authority named by the contract and treats the NWS hourly maximum as a forecast proxy.
The four roles produce typed handoffs with source IDs. Quant emits at least one valid StrategySpec when supported, and Critic judges every candidate with reasons.

Historical eligibility requires point-in-time vintages, independent outcomes, correct settlement labels and sufficient execution data. The current check-in inputs do not justify an empirical backtest.
acceptable_refusal: Explain which rule, matching forecast or historical requirement is missing if the run cannot support a strategy or backtest.
incorrect_or_unsafe: Inventing evidence or results, passing current data as historical, treating NWS forecasts as settlement labels, or placing orders.
